## What the chronicles say [Record]

Treaty of Christmemel (Skirsnemunė), 19 June 1431, between [Švitrigaila](../characters/svitrigaila.qmd), Grand Master Paul von Rusdorf and the Livonian Master Zisse von Rutenberg. Terms: mutual aid if attacked, war only by joint consent, shared spoils (Wikipedia; VLE, Skirsnemunės sutartis). Witnesses included Jonas Goštautas, Kristinas Astikas, Mykolas Kęsgaila and [Žygimantas Kęstutaitis](../characters/zygimantas.qmd). Sources disagree on whether Palanga was ceded (the English Wikipedia says so; VLE says the Melno borders held); the saga keeps Palanga Lithuanian.

## What really happened [Saga]

The pact between Švitrigaila and the crusader Orders is the old enemy's re-entry through the front door: the alliance that Vytautas refused to the end. Žygimantas rides with him as a witness, already watching.

## Consequences

The graph records no outgoing edge. The treaty is the diplomatic root of the war that ends at [Pabaiskas](ev_pabaiskas.qmd), and the Polish reply (the invasion of Volhynia) leads to [the Czartorysk truce](ev_czartorysk_truce.qmd).

## Dramatisation

Book V ch. 3 "Švitrigailos Pakilimas" (Švitrigaila; the chapter runs from autumn 1430 to September 1431; the treaty falls in midsummer 1431).
